name: tune-strip
description: Windows only. Music bar for Spotify above the prompt: album cover, title, artist, position and clickable controls (restart/previous, play/pause, next). Reads the Windows media controls, no login, no network. Finds the beat of the song locally for clawd-buddy (listens to Spotify only, nothing recorded or sent).

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

size.title: Size
size.description: auto: in the desktop the bar above all other band mods, or the compact size in the row when it fits. full: its own bar above the other band mods with cover, title, position bar and all buttons. compact: in the row, cover, title and previous/play/next. mini: in the row, cover and play/pause. off: hidden. /tune size overrides this in all open chats.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the Windows media controls are read while the band is on screen.

extraButtons.title: Extra buttons
extraButtons.description: In the desktop bar, also show −15 s, +15 s, shuffle and repeat next to previous, play/pause and next. The commands /tune back, forward, shuffle and repeat work either way.
